content: Sosep eri ketin poaralahng pohn kahlep en semeo, tentenihr oh metimetik meseo.
Ih eri mahsanihong toakte ko me kin papah, re en kihong wini ni kahlep en eh pahpao.
Re ahpw winiwiniehki erein rahn 40, uwen reireien ahnsou me wini kin kohieng ni kahlep en aramas mehla. Mwuhr, mehn Isip ahpw mwahieiki Seikop erein rahn 70.
Ahnsoun mwahieio lao imwisekla, Sosep ahpw mahsanihong sapwellimen Parao lapalap ako, “Kumwail menlau padahkihong Parao pakair wet:

‘Ni ei pahpao eh pahn mehla, e patohwan peki rehi, I en inoukihong, me I pahn sarepedi nan sousou me e kaunopadahr nan Kenan. Eri, komw kupwurkalahngan mweidohng pwe I en patohla sarepedi semeio, I ahpw pahn patohwan pwurodo.’”
Parao ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Komw ketiwei sarepedi semomwen, duwen omwi ketin inoukihong.”
Sosep eri ketila sarepedi semeo. Sapwellimen Parao lapalap koaros, me mah kan, oh kaun akan koaros en Isip, ahpw iang Sosep patohdahla.
En Sosep eh peneinei koaros, rie ko, oh peneineien eh pahpao pil iang ih kohla. Ihte seri tikitik ko, nair pelinmen kan, sihpw, kuht, oh kou kan, me sohte iang, pwe re mihmihte nan Kosen.
Aramas me dake werennansapw oh me dake oahs akan pil iang patohdahla; lapalahn pokon ehu me wia kaparo.
Ni arail lel wasahn kamwakele kohn nan Atad, ni palimesehn Sordan, re wiahda sarawi lapalap oh reirei ehu en mwahiei. Sosep eri mwahieiki eh pahpao erein rahn isuh.
Ni pwilidak en Kenan ko ar kilangada sarawien mwahieio nan Atad, re nda, “Sarawi lapalap ehu met rehn mehn Isip kan.” Iei kahrepen wasao eh adanekihla Apel Misraim.
Nein Seikop pwutak ko eri kapwaiada dahme arail pahpao kehkehlingkihong irail.
Re walahng nan Kenan, oh sarepedi nan poaren paipo nan Makpela, palimesehn Mamre, wasa me Eipraam pwainsang Epron, mehn Id, pwe en wiahla eh wasahn sousou.
Mwurin Sosep eh sarepedier semeo, e ahpw sapahllahng Isip, iangahki rie ko, oh pil irail koaros me iang patohdahla sarepedi Seikop.
Sosep Kakehlakahla Lamalam en Rie ko
Eri, mwurin mehlahn arail pahpao, rien Sosep ko ahpw patohwan, “Ia duwe, ma Sosep pahn ketin kadakadaur eh kailongkin kitail, oh men dupukohng kitail suwed me kitail wiahiong?”
Irail eri kadaralahng Sosep ilek ehu me ketihtihki, “Mwohn samatailo eh sipalla,

e kehkehlingkihong kiht se en padahkihong komwi, ‘Menlau mahkikihong riomw kan sapwung me re wiahiong uhk.’ Eri, komw kupwurei kiht oh ketin mahkikihong kiht sapwung wet me kiht, ladun Koht en semomwio, wiadahr.” Sosep ahpw tentenihr ni arail patohwanohng mepwukat.
Rie ko eri piserwarodohng reh oh poaridi mwowe, patohwanohng, “Iet kiht sapwellimomwi lidu sohwar ekei.”
Sosep ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail dehr perki mehkot. I sohte kak wiliandi Koht.
Kumwail koasoanehdi kumwail en wiahiong ie me suwed, Koht ahpw ketin kawekiong ni mehkot mwahu, pwe en doarehla mouren aramas ngeder me momourkier rahnwet irair me wiawihero.
Eri, sohte mehkot kumwail pahn masak. I pahn apwalih kumwail oh noumwail seri kan.” Ih duwen eh ketin kakehlakahkinirailda mahsen pwukat me lel oh kamwakidada kapehdirail kan.
Sipallahn Sosep
Sosep eri ketiket nan Isip rehn peneineien eh pahpa; e sounpar 110 ahnsou me eh sipalla.
E ieiasete e lao ketin udiahl nein Epraim nah seri ko, oh pil nein nah seri ko. E pil ieiasete ni ahnsou me Makir nein Manase, nah seri ko ipwidi.

Ih eri mahsanihong rie ko, “I nektehn mehla, ahpw Koht pahn ketin apwalih kumwail oh pahn ketin kahluwaikumwailsang nan sahpwet kahluwaikumwaillahng nan sahpw me e ketin inoukihong Eipraam, Aisek oh Seikop.”

Sosep eri peki rehn mehn Israel ko pwe re en wiahda inou ehu. E mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail inoukihong ie, me ahnsou me Koht pahn ketin kahluwaikumwaillahng nan sahpwo, kumwail pahn wahda paliwereiet.”
Sosep eri sipalla ni eh sounpar 110. Irail eri kihong wini ni kahlepeo oh kihdiong nan kohpwa.

footnotes.text: APEL MISRAIM: Sisen ahd wet ekis duwehte sisen lepin mahsen en Ipru me wehwehki “sarawien mwahiei en mehn Isip.”
